# LAMMPS input script for elastic constants calculation

# Initialization
units metal
dimension 3
boundary p p p
atom_style atomic

# Read structure
read_data Mg.data

# Define potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Mg_Zhou04.eam.alloy Mg

# Energy minimization
minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000

# Set up elastic calculation
change_box all triclinic

# Store initial box dimensions
variable L0x equal lx
variable L0y equal ly
variable L0z equal lz

# Define strain increment (1e-6)
variable up equal 1.0e-6
variable down equal -${up}

# Output file
print "# Strain XX YY ZZ XY XZ YZ" file elastic_stresses.txt
print "# GPa GPa GPa GPa GPa GPa" append elastic_stresses.txt

# Initial stresses
fix 3 all box/relax aniso 0.0

minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000

variable sxx equal pxx*1.0e-4
variable syy equal pyy*1.0e-4
variable szz equal pzz*1.0e-4
variable sxy equal pxy*1.0e-4
variable sxz equal pxz*1.0e-4
variable syz equal pyz*1.0e-4

print "0.000000 ${sxx} ${syy} ${szz} ${sxy} ${sxz} ${syz}" append elastic_stresses.txt

unfix 3

# Deform box for each strain component
# XX strain
variable dir equal 1
variable delta equal ${up}
include deform.mod

# YY strain
variable dir equal 2
include deform.mod

# ZZ strain
variable dir equal 3
include deform.mod

# XY strain
variable dir equal 4
include deform.mod

# XZ strain
variable dir equal 5
include deform.mod

# YZ strain
variable dir equal 6
include deform.mod

# Reset box and coordinates
clear
box tilt large
read_data Mg.data

# Potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Mg_Zhou04.eam.alloy Mg

# Impose strain
if "${dir} == 1" then &
   "change_box all x delta 0 ${delta} remap units box"
if "${dir} == 2" then &
   "change_box all y delta 0 ${delta} remap units box"
if "${dir} == 3" then &
   "change_box all z delta 0 ${delta} remap units box"
if "${dir} == 4" then &
   "change_box all yz delta ${delta} remap units box"
if "${dir} == 5" then &
   "change_box all xz delta ${delta} remap units box"
if "${dir} == 6" then &
   "change_box all xy delta ${delta} remap units box"

# Minimize
minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000

# Compute stress
variable tmp equal ${delta}
variable s1 equal pxx*1.0e-4
variable s2 equal pyy*1.0e-4
variable s3 equal pzz*1.0e-4
variable s4 equal pxy*1.0e-4
variable s5 equal pxz*1.0e-4
variable s6 equal pyz*1.0e-4

print "${tmp} ${s1} ${s2} ${s3} ${s4} ${s5} ${s6}" append elastic_stresses.txt

# LAMMPS input script for elastic constants calculation

# Initialization
units metal
dimension 3
boundary p p p
atom_style atomic

# Read structure
read_data Mg.data

# Define potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Mg_Zhou04.eam.alloy Mg

# Energy minimization
minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000

# Store initial box dimensions
variable L0 equal lx
variable tmp equal ly
variable ly0 equal ${tmp}
variable tmp equal lz
variable lz0 equal ${tmp}

# Define deformation size
variable up equal 1.0e-6
variable down equal -${up}

# Output file
fix output all print 1 "${up} $(pxx) $(pyy) $(pzz) $(pyz) $(pxz) $(pxy)" file elastic.dat screen no

# Perform box deformations
variable i loop 6

label loop_start
  # Reset box to original dimensions
  clear
  read_data Mg.data
  pair_style eam/alloy
  pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Mg_Zhou04.eam.alloy Mg

  # Apply strain
  if "$i == 1" then &
    "change_box all x delta 0 ${up} remap units box"
  if "$i == 2" then &
    "change_box all y delta 0 ${up} remap units box"
  if "$i == 3" then &
    "change_box all z delta 0 ${up} remap units box"
  if "$i == 4" then &
    "change_box all yz delta ${up} remap units box"
  if "$i == 5" then &
    "change_box all xz delta ${up} remap units box"
  if "$i == 6" then &
    "change_box all xy delta ${up} remap units box"

  # Minimize energy
  minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000

  # Output stress components
  run 0
next i
jump SELF loop_start

print "All done"

units metal
dimension 3

pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Al99.eam.alloy Al

# Energy minimization
minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000

# Set up elastic calculation
change_box all triclinic

# Calculate elastic constants
fix 3 all box/relax aniso 0.0

# Define the elastic constants calculation
fix 1 all nve
fix 2 all temp/rescale 1 1.0 1.0 0.1 1.0

# Store initial box dimensions
variable tmp equal "lx"
variable L0 equal ${tmp}
variable tmp equal "ly"
variable L1 equal ${tmp}
variable tmp equal "lz"
variable L2 equal ${tmp}

# Define deformation size
variable up equal 1.0e-6
variable down equal -${up}

# Output commands
thermo 1
thermo_style custom step temp pe press pxx pyy pzz pxy pxz pyz lx ly lz vol
dump 1 all custom 1 dump.elastic id type x y z

# Positive deformation
variable dir loop 6
  label loop_start
  change_box all triclinic
  fix 3 all box/relax aniso 0.0
  minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000
  # Strain application in different directions
  if "$\{dir\} == 1" then &
    "change_box all x delta 0 ${up} remap units box"
  if "$\{dir\} == 2" then &
    "change_box all y delta 0 ${up} remap units box"
  if "$\{dir\} == 3" then &
    "change_box all z delta 0 ${up} remap units box"
  if "$\{dir\} == 4" then &
    "change_box all yz delta ${up} remap units box"
  if "$\{dir\} == 5" then &
    "change_box all xz delta ${up} remap units box"
  if "$\{dir\} == 6" then &
    "change_box all xy delta ${up} remap units box"
  minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000
  run 0
  # Store stress components
  variable tmp equal "pxx"
  variable pxx${dir} equal ${tmp}
  variable tmp equal "pyy"
  variable pyy${dir} equal ${tmp}
  variable tmp equal "pzz"
  variable pzz${dir} equal ${tmp}
  variable tmp equal "pxy"
  variable pxy${dir} equal ${tmp}
  variable tmp equal "pxz"
  variable pxz${dir} equal ${tmp}
  variable tmp equal "pyz"
  variable pyz${dir} equal ${tmp}
  # Restore box
  if "$\{dir\} == 1" then &
    "change_box all x delta 0 ${down} remap units box"
  if "$\{dir\} == 2" then &
    "change_box all y delta 0 ${down} remap units box"
  if "$\{dir\} == 3" then &
    "change_box all z delta 0 ${down} remap units box"
  if "$\{dir\} == 4" then &
    "change_box all yz delta ${down} remap units box"
  if "$\{dir\} == 5" then &
    "change_box all xz delta ${down} remap units box"
  if "$\{dir\} == 6" then &
    "change_box all xy delta ${down} remap units box"
  minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000
next dir
jump SELF loop_start

variable C55 equal "-${pxz5}/(${up})*1.0e-4"

variable C23 equal "-${pyy3}/(${up})*1.0e-4"
